scope: Eight fixed-version serial ROS/Gazebo cases; not full matrix acceptance; no runtime modifications
metric_limits: Metrics cover post-warmup probe window, not whole mission.
Location p95 conditions on fresh confirmed matches within the gate.
Physical bodies include inactive heaters for identity diagnostics.
Source packets grouped by receive-time gaps > 0.05 s; nominal tracker rate is 2 Hz.
Multiple labels need >=3 matched rows per label; simultaneous packet counts are separate.
Inactive delay is unknown when the off transition precedes the probe window.

plan.policy: Fixed runtime code; serial Gazebo cases; retain failures

probe.note: Active truth distance includes predicted tracks after emission stops. Physical source distance includes inactive bodies. Neither is matched precision or recall.
